newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 27 Kurd rebels killed in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 27 Kurd rebels killed in clashes.

text.p: Turkish troops have killed 27 Kurdish guerrillas in clashes over the last week in the southeast of the country, security officials said on Wednesday.
The emergency rule governor's office said in a statement 25 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels were killed in the provinces of Sirnak, Batman and Hakkari.
The statement made no mention of army casualties.
More than 21,000 people have died in the 12-year conflict between Turkish forces and the PKK, fighting for self-rule in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
